gemini_analysis.description: The image shows two people standing close to each other indoors. The person on the left has curly hair and is wearing a white shirt with gold text, while the person on the right is dressed in a red long-sleeve top and dark pants. They appear to be smiling and posing for the photo.
gemini_analysis.description_ru: На изображении показаны два человека, стоящие рядом друг с другом внутри помещения. gemini_analysis.exif_analysis: The photo was taken on March 21, 2016, at 21:18:13 using a Samsung SM-N900 camera with an ISO of 400 and an exposure time of 0.05882 seconds. The image does not contain GPS or location information.
